रौ॑द्र relating to Rudra or the Rudras;
 Rudra-like i.e.
fierce, violent, formidable, inauspicious, n. adv. — m. a descendant or
worshipper of Rudra, pl. a class of evil demons, N. of a people. n.
fierceness, formidableness, horror (also ˚ता† f.), N. of a lunar
mansion.
